notes: Isotope shifts are nu(13C) - nu(12C) (and nu(14C) - nu(12C)); MHz values are unit conversions of shifts printed in cm^-1 or mK (1 cm^-1 = 29979.2458 MHz) and carry a 'derived' note, with the printed number kept in value_cm / value_mK. 12C has I = 0 (no hyperfine structure); 13C has I = 1/2, so only magnetic-dipole A constants exist. The 609 um / 370 um ground-term lines are outside the site's range; their frequencies are kept only under additional_isotope_data because they fix the 13C level positions. g_J values refer to 12C.
